label: Multi-specialty
lead: You added a second doctor. Then a third. Then a dermatologist on weekends. Each one brought their own software, their own forms, their own way of billing. Lucoze undoes all of that.
why: Across cardiology, derm, OPD — the doctor reading next sees the same record. No re-asking, no re-explaining.
One invoice spans 3 doctors and 2 procedures — still GST-compliant, still itemised.
Add a new doctor in 10 minutes — her schedule, her billing rates, her referral chain are inherited from the template.
Front desk in 3 Bihar / UP clinics retrained on Lucoze in 2 hours. Without yelling.
